Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.body: Thank you for your offer. We have reviewed the referenced records and weigh them in our decision. Our revised proposal follows; the referenced data and our volumes support this level. Our own orders for this exact part were placed at 5.26 EUR (po:4500013373-10) and 5.84 EUR (po:4500014427-10); our proposal reflects that record. We commit to a binding volume for the full term: 23,700 units per year over 24 months, firm. (doc:20260922-70740-P18)

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We acknowledge your firm volume commitment of 23,700 units per year and the referenced historical orders. 

In return for the 24-month contract and the volume commitment, we agree to the AS-14404 index clause and 45 days payment terms. Under these revised parameters, we can offer a unit price of €5.60. For this revised Angebot, our terms are a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.body: Thank you for your offer. Our revised proposal follows; our volumes and the referenced market data support this level. We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for staying in touch with us. We appreciate your flexibility regarding payment terms to achieve a better price. 

Please note that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. By adjusting the payment terms to 30 days net, we can reduce our price to €5.50 per unit. You mentioned market data supporting your proposal; please provide these figures so we can review them. Furthermore, our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We can present a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Please keep in mind that our offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
